europe_now.title: Russia-Ukraine Conflict Escalation
europe_now.summary: Russian missile strikes have targeted Kyiv and Zaporizhzhia. These attacks have resulted in rising civilian casualties.

top_stories.title: Geopolitical and Security Developments
top_stories.summary: Baltic defense startups are developing new technologies to counter Russian threats. Meanwhile, Russia is reportedly using fake news to influence German elections.

top_stories.title: Environmental and Climate Challenges
top_stories.summary: France is experiencing a record drought that is impacting the cheese industry. Some analysts suggest that weakening climate rules could lead to economic issues.
